title: Dynamics of Newton's method for odd and even elliptic functions
summary: We investigate Newton's method applied to any odd or any even elliptic function with an arbitrary period lattice. For any function of this type whose set of poles coincides with its period lattice, we show that the Julia set of its Newton map is connected, as long as no Herman rings exist. Moreover, we provide sufficient conditions on the Newton's method of any odd or even elliptic function to exhibit wandering domains coexisting with attracting basins.
